scope: Measured original experiments. Portable release changes workspace/setup/provenance paths and is not a rerun of these measurements.

metric.aggregation: one dataset-level confusion matrix, macro mean over all 32 classes

test_runtime.timing_scope: prediction includes RGB preprocessing, CPU/GPU model transfer, inference and PNG writing; total also includes checkpoint loading and provenance hashing

limitations: Validation images were reused for checkpoint, seed and inference selection.
Pretraining datasets and decoder initialization differ across candidate systems.
Near-location train/val images exist despite no exact pixel duplicates.
Overpass and Pruned Tree have only 40 and 54 validation truth pixels, one image each, and zero IoU in all inference variants.
CUDA deterministic mode was disabled. The reproduction workflow fixes the recipe and records actual artifacts; it does not guarantee byte-identical retraining or the same leaderboard score.
